acceptance_evidence.reference: A disposable copy excluding .git, .pyramid, and .build completed swift package resolve, swift build, and swift test; README.md documents the same commands and Package.swift defines the app, core, and test targets.

discovered_risks: The first sandboxed disposable-copy attempt was blocked by nested sandbox/module-cache restrictions; the identical clean-copy commands passed outside that restriction, so this is recorded as harness behavior rather than a product defect.
The current app target is an intentionally invisible accessory-process skeleton. TASK-112 must provide the first user-visible status item and interaction lifecycle.
An Xcode app/system-extension project is still required before privileged packaging; its exact form remains deferred and must not be inferred from the successful SwiftPM build.
